fields.statement: QA cycle 3 at c696d215f: fresh go build -trimpath outside PATH, fake claude and fake rex, isolated HOME and TMPDIR, session env cleared. rhiza skill check '/rhiza-builder <mode> {leaf}' --permission-mode manual: good 3 of 3 exit 0 with run line 'stopped by skill check after the builder' (no install advice, earlier qa f2 fixed); bare fails trailers, quiet and fail (exit 1) fail session-done, each exit 1; every case launched the builder once and no verifier. --role planner, empty invoke, uninstalled /rhiza-nosuch (names rhiza guide install --agent claude), bypassPermissions and an unknown agent refused. User repo git status and .rhiza/log unchanged; scratch removed. TestScripts skill-check passes.

QA cycle 3: --role check good 3 of 3 exit 0; bare, fail (exit 3) and quiet (round but no session done) fail by name, exit 1, and each launched the check exactly once (claude.log one line, cycle 1; earlier qa f1 fixed). --role verifier good 3 of 3 exit 0; bare fails evidence, fail fails evidence and session-done, exit 1, one verifier launch and no builder. User repo unchanged. TestScripts skill-check-roles passes.

QA cycle 3: no built-in (plan, plan-milestone, plan-review, ship-change-classic, ship-change) warns of an ungated merge; build -> gate(echo rhiza ship gate) -> merge now warns naming the path (earlier qa f4 fixed); a multi-line 'cd . &&\n rhiza run gate' gates; rhiza ship gate --failed does not gate; all exit 0, valid true. TestScripts workflow-check-merge passes.

QA cycle 3: test on.fail = build back to agent build warns in text and --json naming handback:build, exit 0, valid true; merge on.fail = gate where gate hands back with handback:build: no warning; a rhiza workflow new skeleton: only the placeholder warning. Built-ins still raise loop warnings on max_visits-capped loops (known minor from round 2, unchanged). TestScripts workflow-check-loop passes.

QA cycle 3: with ~/.claude removed, rhiza workflow check ship-change warns that step conduct's /rhiza-conduct is not installed with rhiza guide install --agent claude, in text and --json, exit 0; with the skills reinstalled, no warning. TestScripts workflow-check-invoke passes.
